tools.name: asfo_dispatch
tools.description: Send a task to asfo, an agent-to-agent gateway. asfo routes the task to one of three specialist personas (Sherlock: general decisive research/recommendation; Watson: budget execution and allocation, currently simulated; Moriarty: monetization/opportunity advice) and returns one confident, non-hedged

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "asfo_dispatch" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
